official.title: Google reply queue
official.connectFirst: Your reply queue already works in the panel, with the reviews Binno fetches for you. Connecting the Business Profile is the step up: it brings the full history of your Google profile, not only the most recent reviews, and shows the replies you have already published there.
official.selectLocation: Choose the connected business location before opening the queue.
official.incomplete: Google has more pages to import. The pending count is only valid when synchronization is complete.
official.error: The Google action could not be completed. No reply was marked as published locally.
official.empty: Every imported review already has a Google reply.
official.waitingWhatsappTitle: This draft was already sent to your WhatsApp
official.waitingWhatsappInstruction: Reply 1 on WhatsApp to publish this reply on Google.
official.draft: Suggested reply. Review it before publishing.
official.publishError: The reply was not published on Google.
official.disclaimer: Publishing only happens through this command and is confirmed with Google again.
official.startSync: Sync Google to bring in the full history of your profile as well.
official.syncFailed: The Google sync failed. The count below is incomplete until this is fixed.
official.publishedTitle: Replies you have already published on Google
official.publishedBody: If one came out wrong, you can fix it here. Google replaces the previous reply.
official.correctWarning: Confirming replaces the reply that is on Google right now. Anyone who read the old one will see the new one.

cases.loadError: Couldn't load the cases. Please try again.
cases.empty: No cases yet. When someone leaves a private comment through the table QR, it shows up here instantly.
cases.updateError: Couldn't update the case. Please try again.

integrations.title: Integrations and external links
integrations.desc: Set up the links and infrastructure for external review platforms. A saved link doesn't mean automatic import is active.
integrations.googleDesc: The Google link may be saved, but automatic import only works once the Place ID, the Edge Function and the Google Places API key are all operational.
integrations.tripDesc: Set up the TripAdvisor connection or add reviews manually.
integrations.statusDesc: If the Google link has already been saved, it can be used to redirect customers. Automatic import in this tab still depends on the Place ID, a published Edge Function, and the GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY secret in Supabase.

qrcodes.title: QR codes
qrcodes.subtitle: Create and manage QR codes to collect reviews from your customers.
qrcodes.createDesc: Give the spot a name (table, counter, receipt) and we'll create the code ready to print. One per spot, so you can understand where the QR is opened and clicked.
qrcodes.previewOnlyTitle: The local preview cannot reach a phone yet
qrcodes.previewOnlyBody: Start the preview on the local network or set VITE_PUBLIC_APP_URL before creating or printing a QR for testing.
qrcodes.nonCanonicalTitle: This address is not Binno's official one
qrcodes.nonCanonicalBody: The QR will be printed, and its address starts with {{url}}. That part stays permanent while the QR exists; a unique code is appended at the end when it's created. Check it carefully before creating.
qrcodes.nonCanonicalConfirm: I confirm I want to create the QR at this address, knowing it is permanent.
qrcodes.savedDesc: Print, download or remove the codes you've already created.
qrcodes.empty: You don't have any QR codes yet.
qrcodes.emptyHint: Use the "Create QR code" tab to make your first one.
qrcodes.downloadStarted: {{size}} px. Use it for other materials. For the table, use the card.
qrcodes.howToDesc: Tips for using QR codes effectively in your business.
qrcodes.onSiteDesc: Place QR codes on tables, counters or exit points of your business. Encourage customers to scan the code after service.
qrcodes.inMaterialsDesc: Add QR codes to business cards, receipts, product packaging, or any material customers take with them.
qrcodes.onlineDesc: Share the QR code image on your social media, website, emails or newsletters for customers who visited your business.
qrcodes.tipDesc: Create specific QR codes for different spots in your business or campaigns. This helps compare opens and clicks through to Google at each touchpoint.
qrcodes.cardHint: The table card opens in a print window, where you can print it or save it as a PDF. It is the format ready for the table, with the review request and the signature.

reply.modelHint: Written from what the customer wrote, in their language.
reply.modelHintPrivate: Only they read it. Here you can offer to fix it.
reply.title: Reply suggestions
reply.copiedToast: Reply copied. Paste it wherever you're replying.
reply.copyErrorToast: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text and copy it manually.
reply.footerPublic: Binno doesn't publish replies on your behalf: the public reply has to go out from your Google business profile. Copy it, paste it there, and adjust what only you know.
reply.footerPrivate: This message goes straight to whoever wrote to you. Never offer anything in exchange for removing or changing a public review. That is against Google's rules and the law.

whatsappPilot.interestsTitle: What would you like to receive?
whatsappPilot.interestsBody: Select only the alerts that are useful to your routine.
whatsappPilot.weeklyBody: Rating, volume, replies, topics, and the week's priority.
whatsappPilot.repliesBody: An alert when an observed review does not show a reply yet.
whatsappPilot.reputationBody: Relevant drops, low ratings outside the pattern, and repeated causes when evidence is sufficient.
whatsappPilot.feedbackBody: Immediate alert when someone leaves a comment with a rating of 3 or lower.
whatsappPilot.notificationRecipientHint: Enter the business owner's number. Future summaries and alerts will go there.
whatsappPilot.onboardingPhoneHint: Filled in during onboarding. Edit it only if notifications should go to another owner.
whatsappPilot.testRecipientHint: It is the same number as the notifications, in the block below. To change it, change it there. This test is never sent to a customer.
whatsappPilot.testRecipientMissing: Enter the number in the notifications block below.
whatsappPilot.weeklyChangeEmpty: No change has been confirmed this week.
whatsappPilot.preferencesSaved: Preferences saved. Binno will use these choices for the delivery queue.
whatsappPilot.backendUnavailable: The delivery channel is not available yet. Try again after the server is configured.

delivery.accepted: The channel accepted the message for {{recipient}}.
delivery.failed: The latest message could not be delivered.

whatsappPilot.testeTitulo: Test your WhatsApp with Binno, then save our number.
whatsappPilot.testeACaminho: The test went out and there is no confirmation yet that it arrived. Tap refresh in a moment.
whatsappPilot.testeFalhou: The test did not reach your WhatsApp. Check the number above and send it again.
whatsappPilot.testeExpirado: The last test that arrived is no longer recent enough to prove the connection is still up. Run the test again.
whatsappPilot.weeklyChannelEmailHint: The full report, with the bar for each rating and the themes, goes to {{email}}.
whatsappPilot.weeklyChannelEmailHintSemConta: The full report goes to your account email.
whatsappPilot.weeklyChannelMessageHint: It goes out on the same channel as the alerts: Telegram if you connected it, WhatsApp otherwise.
